{{Quote|I did not come to make small talk. I need somewhere to bunk while I track down my clan's enemies.|Akaavi Spar, speaking with the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of a smuggler ship|audio=NoSmallTalk-AkaaviSpaar-TOR.flac|<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Akaavi Spar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Soldier/Legends|warrior]] of [[Clan Spar]] who lived during the [[Great Galactic War]] and the subsequent [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. While away with a [[Zadik Lone|lover]], Spar's clan was [[Death/Legends|destroyed]] by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Empire on false criminal charges, and when her [[Clan Lone|lover's clan]] refused to rally to the aid of hers, Spar set out alone to seek revenge. Joining the crew of an up-and-coming [[Voidhound|smuggler]] on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], Spar traced the conspiracy against her clan through the Imperial hierarchy, confronting [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Tyrak]] and [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Stanwu]] in pursuit of the truth, before discovering that the attack on her clan had come as the result of lies told to the Empire by the Mandalorian pretender, [[Tayari Rook]]. Spar tracked Rook and his [[Clan Rook/Legends|false clan]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], where she struck down Rook and any of his criminal compatriots that didn't flee, claiming vengeance for the death of her clan.

==Biography==
===Early life===
{{Quote|I have called myself Mandalorian since I left my mother's side at age three to begin training.|Akaavi Spar|audio=LeftMyMother-AkaaviSpar-TOR.flac|<ref name="TOR" />}}
Born a member of the respected [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Clan Spar]], Akaavi Spar was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]].<ref name="AkaaviCodex" /> At the age of three, Spar left her [[Parent/Legends|mother]] to begin her Mandalorian training;<ref name="TOR:TToTR" /> this was tradition in the Mandalorian culture, though Spar began several [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to the more typically accepted age of eight years old.<ref name="TMPaC">{{InsiderCite|86|The Mandalorians: People and Culture}}</ref> Trained in the use of a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] and [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]] from youth, Spar possessed few if any friends during her childhood,<ref name="TOR:TToTR" /> but quickly became one of her clan's best [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]]. When she was only eight years old, Spar [[Death/Legends|killed]] an abusive [[Abyssin/Legends|Abyssin]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] with an improvised [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrower]], earning her the nickname of "Firehand" among her clan mates.<ref name="AkaaviCodex" />

She later embarked on a career as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]],<ref name="AkaaviCodex" /> working with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]<ref name="TOR:IV" /> the Mandalorians under [[Mandalore the Vindicated]] had allied with during the [[Great Galactic War]],<ref name="Mandalore">{{HolonetOld|biographies|mandalore|Mandalore}}</ref> capturing or killing individuals ranging from common criminals to [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].<ref name="AkaaviCodex" /> She soon earned the nickname "[[Akk dog/Legends|Akk hound]]" from the Empire after her success in eliminating alone the entire [[Suns of Ryloth]], an anarchist, anti-Imperial, [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] group on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] that had resisted the Empire for months.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

As an adult, Akaavi Spar met and fell in love with fellow Mandalorian warrior, [[Zadik Lone]], and left Clan Spar to join [[Clan Lone|Lone's clan]]. Her departure spared Spar from the fate of her clan, [[Death/Legends|destroyed]] by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Empire<ref name="TOR:ZL" /> on false charges of [[Treason/Legends|treason]].<ref name="TOR:IV" /> When Spar learned of this, she called upon her lover's clan for assistance in rallying support for Clan Spar, but the members of Clan Lone refused to provide help,<ref name="TOR:ZL" /> despite the culture's traditional expectation to offer aid to any other Mandalorian in need.<ref name="APM">''[[Boba Fett: A Practical Man]]''</ref> Disgusted by their inaction, Spar ended her relationship with Zadik and abandoned Clan Lone<ref name="TOR:ZL" /> in order to seek out vengeance against those within the Empire who were responsible for her clan's demise.<ref name="TOR:IV" />

===Balmorra and Voidhound===
[[File:Akaavi_Spar.png|thumb|left|200px|Akaavi Spar]]
Eventually, Akaavi and [[Unidentified Mandalorian (Clan Spar)|another]] survivor of her clan became mercenaries employed by the Empire. In [[3642 BBY]], they were stationed in [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|battle]] that raged there, between Empire and the [[Balmorran resistance]], the latter directly supported by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Akaavi and an Imperial troop contingent encountered the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] later known as [[Voidhound]] during his [[Mission to the Okara Droid Factory|infiltration]] in the [[Okara Droid Factory]]. She refused to accept the Imperials' order to attack the smuggler, joining forces with Voidhound instead, slaying the entire squad of [[Imperial soldier]]s. She then asked the Smuggler to give her access to [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Tyrak]], since she wanted to know why the Moff was working with the Resistance and against Imperial interests.<ref name="TOR" />

Akaavi joined forces with the smuggler once again to infiltrate [[Camp Vigil]] so the smuggler would help her rescue her fellow Mandalorian, a captive of the Empire after her betrayal. However, when they arrived in the cell block the Mandalorian had already been executed. With this turn of events, Akaavi, now the sole survivor of Clan Spar, unleashed her anger at the Imperial forces by destroying the entire base with Voidhound's support.<ref name="TOR" />

[[File:Akaavi_Tyrak.png|thumb|right|250px|On Balmorra Akaavi learned that Tyrak wasn't the one responsible for the death of her clan.]]
Akaavi later assisted the smuggler at the [[Balmorran Arms Factory]] during an Imperial ambush. Once all the attackers were dispatched, Akaavi confronted Tyrak over the execution of her clan. However, to her surprise, the man standing before her was not the sadistic Moff she had imagined. Tyrak explained he had only ordered Clan Spar's destruction because he was just given an execution order and he signed it without knowing if her clan was guilty or not. Though Akaavi wanted to kill the Moff still, the smuggler encouraged her to give Tyrak to the Republic so his information can be used against the Empire. Akaavi accepted the Voidhound's reasoning and mentioned that without a clan, she suggested that she join the smuggler's crew as an extra gun.<ref name="TOR" />

Later, when the [[Harridax Kirill|Voidwolf]] revealed that [[Darmas Pollaran]] and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bevera Dodonna]] were working with the Empire, Akaavi realized that half the Imperial leadership on Balmorra executed by the Voidwolf were the enemies of [[Rogun Matt'rik|Rogun the Butcher]].<ref name="TOR" />

Over the years, Akaavi Spar eliminated every members of the [[22nd Regiment]] that participated in the destruction of Clan Spar.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Before long, Akaavi discovered the identity of the Imperial officer who sent the order for her clan's execution: [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Stanwu]], a liaison for bounty hunters. Upon hearing that Stanwu was on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] for recruitment, she decided it was time to set herself up as a hunter-for-hire and wait for the right moment to shoot the Major on sight. However, as he was laid at Akaavi's mercy, Stanwu panicked and confessed that he had been given evidence of Clan Spar's "crimes" by a fellow Mandalorian named [[Tayari Rook]]. Akaavi, angered even further, left Stanwu alive to report her findings to the Voidhound.<ref name="TOR:IV" />

[[File:Akaavi_Spar_in_action.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Akaavi Spar in combat]]
Akaavi spent time digging up information on Tayari Rook, but could not find anything on how he had earned the name "Mandalorian."<ref name="TOR:TToTR" /> Further investigation showed that Rook was nothing more than a conman, setting himself as the head of his criminal enterprise under the guise of "[[Clan Rook/Legends|Clan Rook]]." Even worse was that the disgraced Clan Lone, including Akaavi's former lover Zadik, had joined forces with Rook and his crew. Akaavi had tracked all her enemies down to [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], where they were doing business with the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]]. Finding Clan Rook's discipline seriously lacking, she had an easy time killing all those who stood in her way one by one; some of Clan Lone, however, were smart enough to escape. Before Akaavi killed Tayari Rook, he confessed that he only sold Clan Rook to the Empire to gain a profitable contract.<ref name="TOR:CR">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Akaavi Spar|Clan Rook}}</ref>

With her clan avenged,<ref name="TOR:CR" /> Akaavi decided to stay with the Voidhound,<ref name="TOR:CaC">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Akaavi Spar|Concessions and Confessions}}</ref> grateful for the the assistance they had given her.<ref name="TOR:CR" /> At one point, she had some trouble with [[Languss Tuno]], who was staring at her in an "inappropriate way" thrice. She threatened to gouge his eyes out if he didn't stop. Tuno decided to keep a respectful distance after that.<ref name="TOR:TMC">{{TORcite|type=message|The Mon Calamari|Akaavi}}</ref>

===After the Eternal Empire===
{{Quote|Mako learns quickly. She's good with tech. And she kept me from becoming someone I never wanted to be.|Akaavi Spar|<ref name="TOR:TTR" />}}
[[File:Akaavi_Spar_and_Mako.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Akaavi Spar with her new partner, Mako]]
During the [[Eternal Empire conquest]], the smuggler went missing.<ref name="TOR:TTR" /> Some time afterward, [[Mandalore the Avenger]] summoned all of the Mandalorians to join her in the [[War against Zakuul]].<ref name="KotFE 14">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=14}}</ref>

At some point, Akaavi went back to [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunting]] before eventually teaming up with the tech slicer [[Mako (slicer)|Mako]], after they both tracked a target to [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. The two became a bounty hunting duo, specifically only taking contracts for criminals and other bad guys. The two would later be recruited into the [[Eternal Alliance]] by the [[Alliance Commander]] while they were hunting down [[Les Madrin]], who they were hired to kill.<ref name="TOR:TTR" />

Akaavi then became involved into the Mandalorian politics when Shae Vizla's position was challenged by [[Field Marshal/Legends|Field Marshal]] [[Heta Kol]] and her [[Hidden Chain]]. When Shae Vizla asked the Alliance a favor in tracking down Heta Kol's supply lines, [[Lana Beniko]] recommended Akaavi as an asset on the ground, to which the Commander agreed.<ref name="TOR:RA">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=general|Relentless Ambitions|Odessen}}</ref> After returning from this assignment, Akaavi personally delivered the news to the Commander first before helping Alliance analyst go over her report in detail.<ref name="TOR:WitF">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=general|Whispers in the Force|Odessen}}</ref>

[[File:Akaavi_Spar_on_Ruhnuk.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Akaavi Spar on Ruhnuk]]
When Shae finally tracked down her nemesis to [[Ruhnuk]], Akaavi Spar joined [[Torian Cadera]] as reinforcements for the Mandalore, Alliance Commander and [[Rass Ordo]]. Rass proposed that Shae and the Commander go to the [[Ruhnuk Communications Tower]] while the rest secure their position. The Commander stopped by to check up with Akaavi before proceeding on their way. While the Mandalore and the Commander were gone, the rest were attacked by a [[Clan Varad]] patrol but were able to fight them off and stood their ground. The duel between Shae Vizla and Heta Kol eventually turned into a full-blown battle between two Mandalorian factions, in which Akaavi fought on the Mandalore's side. Shae was seriously wounded in the battle, but stood her ground while Heta Kol and the Hidden Chain escaped. After the battle Shae Vizla was taken to a medical facility and attended by medical droids, and Akaavi Spar and Torian Cadera stayed with her while Rass and [[Jekiah Ordo]] remained outside.<ref name="TOR:SoR" />

==Equipment==
[[File:Akaavi_Spar_waiting.jpg|thumb|right|150px||Akaavi Spar in her Mandalorian Armor]]
As an adult, Akaavi Spar wore a set of cobalt [[blue]] [[Mercenary Elite Prototype Armor|Mandalorian armor]] with dark [[Gold/Legends|gold]] accents over a largely [[gray]] [[Flight suit/Legends|flight suit]]. The helmet she carried had belonged to her deceased father. One of her [[Armor/Legends|armor's]] [[Gauntlet/Legends|gauntlets]] featured a [[Whipcord launcher/Legends|whipcord launcher]] with a [[Grappling hook/Legends|grappling hook]], allowing her to latch on to tall structures and use the device to hoist herself up. In addition to her armor, Spar wore [[Boot/Legends|boots]], [[Glove/Legends|gloves]] over each hand, and a multi-strap [[Utility belt/Legends|utility belt]]. She owned at least one [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] in addition to a [[Electrostaff/Legends|tech staff]] which she wielded in battle, and was known to make use of [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]] to engage large groups of enemies. Spar also carried a personal [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|What was the breakdown of the character like, the description of Akaavi before you got the role?''"<br />"''It was pretty specific. Under appearance it said 'beautiful devil woman, large and intimidating', and under demeanor it said 'no nonsense, to the point of insanity, will kill a dozen men just to get a chance to talk'.''"<br />"''So now that you've seen Akaavi, what do you think of her?''"<br />"''I think she's pretty hot. I like the red face and the horns, and I like how tough she is.|Actress [[Stacy Haiduk]] describes her initial look at Akaavi Spar|<ref name="Stacy" />}}
Akaavi Spar first appeared in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]]-made [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. In the game, Spar acts as a companion character and potential romance option to a Smuggler-class player,<ref name="TOR" /> and was voiced by [[Actor/Legends|actress]] [[Stacy Haiduk]].<ref name="Stacy Haiduk Info">{{WebCite|url=http://stacyhaiduk.info|text=Stacy Haiduk|archivedate=20180317180651}}</ref> Haiduk enjoyed the experience of portraying Spar, and has expressed her support of both Akaavi's exotic appearance and tough attitude.<ref name="Stacy">{{WebCite|url=http://stacyhaiduk.info/stacy-as-akaavi-spar-in-star-wars-the-old-republic|text=Interview with Stacy Haiduk on her role as Akaavi Spar|work=stacyhaiduk.info|archivedate=20120617175921}}</ref>

Spar can be romanced by a male smuggler player, though marriage isn't conclusive due to her loyalty to Mandalorian culture.<ref name="TOR" />

The mission to recruit Akaavi and Mako into the Eternal Alliance is only available to the smuggler and the bounty hunter.<ref name="TOR:TTR" />
